{{Short description|Number that is the numerator of the generalized harmonic number H_(n,2)}}
{{distinguish|Wolstenholme prime}}
In [[mathematics]], a '''Wolstenholme number''' is a [[natural number|number]] that is the [[numerator]] of the [[Harmonic number#Generalized harmonic numbers|generalized harmonic number]] ''H''<sub>''n'',2</sub>.

The first such numbers are 1, 5, 49, 205, 5269, 5369, 266681, 1077749, ... {{OEIS|id=A007406}}.

These numbers are named after [[Joseph Wolstenholme]], who proved [[Wolstenholme's theorem]] on modular relations of the generalized harmonic numbers.
